Hi Sara — great question, thanks for flagging. Short answer: yes, we can typically apply accelerator credits toward reserved capacity in certain circumstances, but there are a few commercial and accounting considerations.

A quick proposal to move the conversation forward (options):
1) Short reserved burst (3 weeks demo + 1 week ramp): credits convert at 70% of face value toward committed spend. No change to core contract; we issue a credit memo against the reserved invoice.
2) 3-month reserved commitment: credits convert at 80% if you sign a 3-month commit (min $5k/mo). We would execute a short addendum and issue an invoice net of the credit.
3) 6-month reserved commitment: credits convert at 85% and we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $500 toward setup. This would be an addendum + PO.

Notes / constraints:
- Accounting will need a signed MCOPA / mutual commercial addendum to recognize the credits as offset to invoicing; they cannot be converted on a handshake.
- For US tax treatment we treat the applied credit as a deduction from invoiced revenue — Lauren from finance (cc'd) can confirm specifics.
- Legal typically requires the MCOPA amendment (1 page) signed; Marissa / Ben, can you confirm the template and turnaround?

If you're open, I'll ask Marissa to draft the addendum for option 2 and 3 (flex to change numbers), and Lauren will flag any AR docs required. If Axiom prefers the short burst (option 1), we can do a credit memo but it requires the usage report and PO for audit trail.

Let me know which option you'd prefer and I'll move the paperwork. I'm free for a 20-min call tomorrow afternoon if you want to run numbers.

Best,

Counterproposal (aimed to keep ops light):
- Acceptable conversion: 85% credit value if Axiom signs a 6-month reserved commitment (we'd set a monthly minimum based on your recent 30-day peak).
- Commitment addendum: 1-page SOW addendum + updated invoice showing credits applied. Finance will treat the credit as a reduction on the invoice (no separate cash movement).
- Documentation: Please sign the attached MCOPA — this is standard and closes the audit trail.

If 6 months feels too long, we can do a 3-month commit at 80% conversion and the onboarding credit Michael mentioned ($500). Ben, can you confirm the pricing band for a $5k-$12k/month bucket so I can provide firm numbers?
